skill: Construct and solve a well-mixed variable-volume first-order linear mixture model, determine the overflow time from capacity, and evaluate solute mass there.
learner_operation: Translate incoming concentration and both flow rates into Q' = c*r_in - r_out*Q/(V0+(r_in-r_out)*t); solve with Q(0)=Q0, compute t_o=(capacity-V0)/(r_in-r_out), evaluate and round mass, then select among five nearby numerical masses.
reasoning_steps: Find net volume growth and overflow time.
Compute solute inflow and time-dependent outflow.
Use a variable-coefficient integrating factor and the initial condition.
Evaluate at overflow and round to one decimal place.
response_contract: All 11 supplied bank questions use one radio field with five math mass choices in lb; ten have keys and solutions, one lacks both. Canonical example has a worked solution but no answer bank.
difficulty: Supplied tagged bank items are easy; calculator allowed/required; all have r_out/(r_in-r_out)=2 and positive incoming concentration exceeding initial concentration. Preserve comparable elementary integration workload.
invariants: Well-mixed single tank, constant positive inflow/outflow and incoming concentration.
Capacity greater than initial volume and inflow greater than outflow so a finite positive overflow time exists.
Mass balance, initial condition, capacity-defined evaluation time and consistent units.
Five numerical radio choices with one correct rounded mass.
